Starting Monday, March 30, the Legacy Trail will close between Newtown Springs Drive and Citation Blvd.
Crews will construct a safer crossing for pedestrians and bicyclists and continue working on the widening project.
During the closure, bicyclists will detour using Citation Blvd, Newtown Center Way and Newtown Springs Drive.
This portion of the trail will reopen once work is complete.
